title: West Midlands and UK-eligible remote vacancy source register
purpose: Research catalogue for a proposed graduate job-matching application; not an active collection configuration or a vacancy database.

scope.remote_rule: Include employers anywhere only when the specific role permits UK-based working; unresolved cases stay labelled. Hybrid workplace and attendance must be retained.
scope.salary_rule: Optional employer-advertised information only; no required salary target or inferred pay.

evidence_status_definitions.advert_inspected: Relevant employer/agency/board advert read; may be experienced/senior or undated, and application acceptance not tested.
evidence_status_definitions.search_route_verified: Credible search/category/recruitment route plus relevant evidence; no guarantee of a current suitable vacancy.
evidence_status_definitions.recruitment_route_verified: Official general recruitment/referral route checked; current analytical vacancy not demonstrated.
evidence_status_definitions.programme_verified: Relevant employer programme established; not proof of a current paid opening.
evidence_status_definitions.documented_route_only: Official technical/feed route established; actual relevant local or UK-eligible vacancy contribution untested.
evidence_status_definitions.indexed_advert_only: Relevant official/agency-authored advert indexed, but live detail not reliably verified.
evidence_status_definitions.historical_or_closed: Relevant regional example closed or old; future monitoring lead only.
evidence_status_definitions.unverified_lead: Source retained for further checks; current usable search or local supply not verified.

limitations: No exhaustive vacancy census or systematic all-source-by-all-location query sweep completed.
No search result counts treated as unique vacancy totals.
No accounts, keys, scraping, scheduled monitoring, connectors or application implementation created.
Evidence dates are check dates; underlying pages may be cached or undated.
Source entries are not independent feeds: employer portals, agency adverts and boards overlap.
All collection switches remain false; research discovery is separate from reuse approval.

access_platform_reference.notes: GET public without authentication; board token and EU/global instance matter. No all-employer search or blanket reuse conclusion.
Company namespace; not full-text cross-employer search. Confirm reuse and CORS constraints; application POST is outside project scope.

access_platform_reference.route: Published-job account endpoint or authorised SPI
access_platform_reference.notes: Public published account endpoint documented; token-backed internal jobs API separate. Employer account identity and reuse not assumed.
Public scope still uses secret API key; not an unauthenticated global feed. Employer/key authorisation required.
Official customer/public-posting docs exist; authentication/scope and external reuse need checking. Do not access internal postings or confuse partner distribution feed with public search.
Official documentation URL could not be retrieved. Do not rely on third-party endpoint claims; verify documentation before onboarding.
Relevant public employer boards found. No universal unauthenticated vacancy-search API or reuse licence established. Do not reverse engineer hidden/private endpoints.
